description.en: The list of model configurations to create.

是否设为默认模型，一个模型分组下最多有一个默认模型。
description.en: Specifies whether to set this model as the default model. Each model group can have at most one default model.

description.en: The ID of the model provider template to which the models belong.

descriptions.zh:
您可以在无影 Agent 管理中心的模型服务商模板下批量创建模型模板，支持一次性添加多个模型并指定其中一个为默认模型。已存在的模型将自动跳过，不会重复创建。

请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解无影 Agent 管理中心的操作与使用。
descriptions.en:
You can create model templates in batches under a model provider template in the Wuying Agent Management Center. You can add multiple models at a time and specify one of them as the default model. Existing models are automatically skipped and are not created again.

Before you call this operation, make sure that you are familiar with the operations and usage of the Wuying Agent Management Center.
